on 19 September, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:59984
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 11258 of 2023
Applicant :- Dharmendra Kaushal

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Deptt. Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Vivek Kumar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vivek Kumar Shukla, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rakesh Kumar Singh, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
307 of 2020, under Sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 506 IPC, Police Station Jagdishpur District Amethi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 31.08.2020 against 11 named accused persons, including the applicant, alleging that some of the co-accused persons introduced themselves as officials of Anee Group of Companies/ Anee Bullion and they induced the informant to make investments in the company.
The informant and numerous other persons made investments in the company but thereafter office of the company was closed and the amount invested was not refunded to the informant.

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

5. In para 16 of the affidavit filed in support of bail application there is a mention of applicant's involvement in total 49 criminal cases including the present case filed by the persons who had made investments in the aforesaid company.
The applicant has been granted bail in several cases of similar nature and copies of her bail orders are annexed with the affidavit.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that several co-accused person Anjani Kaushal Rajesh Kumar Vishwakarma and Basudev Goswami have been granted bail by means of orders dated 21.07.2023, 08.09.2023 and 11.05.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Applications No.9203 of 2023, 10211of 2022 and 15378 of 2022 respectively.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Applications No.9203 of 2023, 10211of 2022 and 15378 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 7. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

8. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the FIR does not contain allegation of any act of commission by the applicant; that co-accused persons have already been granted bail; that the applicant has also been granted bail in several other similar cases and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
9. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
